title: eriogonum ovalifolium var. anserinum
intro: Eriogonum ovalifolium var. anserinum, commonly known as Anserina or Mormon Tea, is a plant species that is native to the western regions of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic and to help reduce fever, which makes it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, urinary tract infections, and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Anserina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the body. Bioactive constituents of Anserina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
